title: Riverbend HIM Fee Schedule: Patient Copy Charges for Medical Records Request (Release of Information)
content:
Schedule of the fee basis and the patient-side copy charges for each request type of the Medical Records Request (Release of Information) product, as set by Riverbend Regional Health's Health Information Management department.

## Fee basis by request type

| Request type | Fee basis of the request type |
|---|---|
| Patient Access - Electronic Copy | flat electronic fee |
| Patient Access - Paper Copy | cost-based paper fee |
| Patient-Directed Transmission to a Third Party | flat electronic fee or cost-based paper fee |
| Authorized Release - Attorney or Legal Representative | third-party release schedule |
| Authorized Release - Insurer or Disability Carrier | third-party release schedule |
| Amendment of Health Record Request | no fee |
| Accounting of Disclosures Request | first accounting free, then a flat fee |

## Patient copy charges

The charges below carry the same figures under all seven request types — Patient Access - Electronic Copy, Patient Access - Paper Copy, Patient-Directed Transmission to a Third Party, Authorized Release - Attorney or Legal Representative, Authorized Release - Insurer or Disability Carrier, Amendment of Health Record Request and Accounting of Disclosures Request.

| Charge | What it is | Figure for every request type |
|---|---|---|
| Flat electronic fee | the all-inclusive flat fee for an electronic copy under patient access | $6.50 |
| Paper cost per page | the cost-based fee per page, covering labor and supplies, for a patient's paper copy | $0.12 per page |
| Patient media fee | the cost of a CD or DVD when the patient asks for imaging on media | $3.00 |
| Postage | how postage is charged | actual postage |
| Page count | how pages are counted for fees | pages produced |
| Paid rush processing | whether paid rush processing is offered | not offered |

## Schedule notes

- The flat electronic fee of $6.50 is all-inclusive: it is the whole charge for an electronic copy under patient access.
- The paper figure of $0.12 is a per-page figure counted on the pages produced, not on the pages requested.
- Postage on a mailed paper copy is the actual postage, not a fixed amount.
- The patient media fee of $3.00 is the cost of one CD or DVD carrying imaging the patient asked for on media.
- No request type offers paid rush processing.
